EXPLANATION: Strong ester C=O stretch at 1733 cm⁻¹ and intense C=C band at 1642 cm⁻¹ fit an allyl methacrylate-type ester. Multiple vinylic/aliphatic C–H stretches at 2938, 3005, 3056, and 3124 cm⁻¹ are consistent with a terminal vinyl group plus substituted C=C. Bands at 1302 and 1327 cm⁻¹ match methacrylate C–O/CH bending features, and weak CH₃ deformation near 1442/1407/1382 cm⁻¹ supports a methyl-substituted double bond. Aldehyde candidates would show aldehyde C–H stretches (~2720–2830 cm⁻¹), absent here; cyclic carbonate/anhydride options would shift/split ν(C=O) higher than observed.
